_real_world.class: AN/SQS-53C(V)1 bow-mounted active/passive hull sonar within AN/SQQ-89(V)
_real_world.variant_scope: Arleigh Burke class (both Flight IIA and Flight II hulls in this OOB).

_provenance.modeling_note: Active/passive bow-mounted hull sonar for Arleigh Burke DDGs. Detection ranges are not public (R18); the repo's existing AN_SQQ-89 MVP module models a passive-only hull sonar, so this CSG-specific record adds an active mode and a source-level field to represent SQS-53C's active capability, kept as a separate mount alongside the towed array per the authoring standard. Values otherwise follow the repo's passive hull-sonar MVP calibration pattern (community-derived approximation / engineering calibration), not authoritative SQS-53C performance.

sonar.mode.note: SQS-53C is an active/passive system, unlike the existing repo passive-only hull sonar MVP

sonar.max_range_m.note: not public (R18); carried from the repo's existing passive hull-sonar MVP calibration, unchanged

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; engineering estimate reflecting an active-sonar ping cycle, longer than the passive MVP baseline's scan period

sonar.detection_threshold_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.track_memory_s.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.bearing_noise_std_deg.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; active-mode range accuracy is typically better than passive-only, so set slightly better than the passive MVP baseline (engineering estimate)

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.ambient_noise_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.source_level_reference_db.note: no public SQS-53C source level; 235 dB re 1uPa @ 1m is an engineering-estimate active-sonar source level typical of large bow-mounted hull arrays of this era

sonar.source_level_speed_factor_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate paired with source_level_reference_db to model modest speed-dependent self-noise increase on the source level

sonar.transmission_loss_alpha_db_per_km.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline (generic underwater transmission-loss constant)

sonar.layer_break_penalty_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.convergence_zone_bonus_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate scaled with max_range_m

sonar.baffle_exclusion_deg.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline (bow-mounted array's stern baffle exclusion)

sonar.ownship_quieting_speed_mps.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo passive hull-sonar MVP baseline

sonar.active_ping_source_level_db.note: set equal to source_level_reference_db per the engine's active-sonar convention; same basis as that field

sonar.confirm_hits_m.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.confirm_window_n.note: standard engine detection-confirmation default, not sourced per-platform

sonar.passive_only.note: false: SQS-53C has an active transmit mode, unlike the repo's passive-only hull sonar MVP

sonar.bearing_only.note: false: hull-mounted active/passive sonar provides range as well as bearing
